facts.fact: Somalia's NIRA director general said ID authentications for service access are growing by the day, with more than 24 public and private sector services integrated with the national ID system.
NIRA says more than 24 public and private sector services have integrated the national ID system and use it for authentication.

NIRA's director general said at least one million citizens were enrolled for the national ID, about 5% of Somalia's 19.7 million people (share calculated here from the population held, not stated by the document).

SOM.note: NIRA runs the programme and the World Bank funds it, but who operates and maintains the platform is not stated.
Services integrate the ID, but no public register keyed on the ID number is named.

facts.fact: Somalia's National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA) said at least one million citizens were enrolled in the World Bank-funded national ID programme, with a target of 15 million issued IDs by 2029.
